judgement.overall_note: Production correctly preserved all at-risk carryover items and added one new bullet capturing the Merton/Advaita/approval-seeking cross-framework mapping. However, that single bullet is too compressed: it omits the specific characterization of original sin as pride of the separate self, the explicit Maya label, and the key sub-claim that the user's ego treats the self as an object to be optimized and validated—losing the second gold 'should_add' item entirely. The wording quality is otherwise high throughout the state. The main weakness is under-specification of the new spiritual framework agreement, collapsing two distinct gold items into one coarser bullet.
